children: This is the wave structure subpage for Banlands. It contains its every past wave layout.
These are the current and former wave layouts for the
names indicate an enemy type's debut.
Great! Just perfect! I can't believe this is how I'm going to die!
Stuck in some idea dump that the writer scrapped.
Honestly, I'm starting to think you deserve it.
Those blue crystals are speeding them up! We need to work around it somehow.
Hey, do you think the testing facility is alright?
I hope so. It seems like whoever took the cube piece stopped our realm from destabilizing. I think for now we should focus on finding a way home.
V has been creating technology in Cyber City for years, so I trust her to figure something out. As for the duck? He's a hit or miss. I think the dude's a war criminal.
I thought I was bad, but you guys are INSANE!
"A large flying creature is inbound!" See, that's what you sounded like. That's you.
Do-...Do I really sound like that?
So, tell me Narrator. Who is this 'Rift Walker'?
The great and powerful Rift Walker! A being who transcends time and is obsessed with keeping the
"balanced"-or whatever. Don't do this, don't do that, don't end an entire lineage 'just because'. Where's the chaos? Where's the drama? The guy's a total bore!
Seriously! He's been like that since the Old World.
These creatures are strong. Do you think it has to do with the unstable energy Professor V was talking about?
I am not sure, but I'm worried what will happen if we stay here too long. I don't want to turn into one of those things.
Don't worry, I don't think they want to turn into you either.
So tell me, do you guys ever get tired of ruining other people's shows?
You shoved yourself into my narrative and turned my masterpiece into a disaster! You suck!
He's really not going to let that go, is he?
If we survive this, I'm going to make sure you're written off for good!
That's it! I think I'm going to write my own story and make you a background character!
Hold on-do you see that? It looks like our Medic! It's even healing the other creatures.
Take it down quickly, and whatever you do, don't mention this to her. She'll beg me to bring one back alive.
She'll DEFINITELY want to dissect it.
That Null Electroshocker is looking extremely unstable.
Oh, come on. It'll be fun! If you get too close it'll be like a party popper! Maybe you'll even get guts and all!
That is a HORRIBLE mental image!
A Null Pyro is on his way!
"A Null Pyro is on his way!"
Oh man, I really do sound like that!
Why are you even helping the Children of Exo anyway? Did Exo get tired of the comedian?

COMEDIAN? I am a PERFORMER! An ARTIST! A DIRECTOR! I've been beside Lord Exo long before you came into your worthless existence! I'm the favorite, ME! He even gave me my beloved hands. Isn't that right, Lefty and Righty?
Ugh, I wonder if we're going to get to the filler wave.
Finally! It's time! The show is about to begin! Oh, I wish I had popcorn as I watch the Null Guardian rip you to pieces!
You say that like he's not coming for you right after!
Ugh! Forget him. Commander, let's take this guy down!

One icon and dialogue is randomly chosen upon defeat:
•We're toast!
•Mission Failed, we'll get em' next time.
•Mistakes are just part of the journey..
